prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a review sheet with THREE separated wide side-view garden terrain samples stacked vertically, actual transparent background. Use attached images only as references for existing game's hand-painted storybook rendering, green leaf shapes and warm earth colors. Draw terrain only, no characters or house. Each row is a single unified painted terrain cross-section, 4 times wider than tall. Row 1: flat garden earth with low leafy surface growing gradually into a SHORT patch of tall grass in its center and gradually back to low foliage; show both natural earth cliff ends. Row 2: a smooth shallow rounded hill, low leafy ground surface follows curve, a small integrated tuft patch on the slope, earth remains solid beneath. Row 3: close-up natural right cliff edge with grass tapering into low leaves at the lip, fine roots emerging from same soil. CRITICAL: grass and low leaves share ONE continuous organic rooted surface; tall blades emerge BETWEEN same low leaves, no second soil slab under grass, no rectangular grass overlay, no pasted-on sticker silhouette, no dark outline seam between vegetation types. Soil warm fine textured ochre brown with small stones, fine roots concentrated just beneath surface gradually fading into earth. Natural irregular soil cutout ends with small soil clumps and fine roots; avoid cylindrical rounded-end floating platforms, avoid repeated large ornamental roots, no blurry stretched texture. Consistent crisp detail scale across soil and roots. Strict orthographic side view, almost no visible top plane; compact plant density matching reference 1 but taller blades from reference 2. Plenty of transparent separation between rows. No text, labels, checkerboard, backdrop, shadow outside terrain or technical lines. This is an exploratory terrain review sheet, not approved game integration.
estado: Amostra exploratória aguardando avaliação humana; fundo colorido apesar da solicitação de transparência; sem integração ao jogo.
